page0.text:
The gigantic figure flies through the air.
This "Berserker" comes tearing down from the top of the hill almost faster than I can follow!

page1.text:
"Shirou, stay back...!"
In the moonlight...
...a shower of...bullet-things rain onto the onrushing giant like shooting stars...!

page2.text:
""
So, this is supernatural accuracy at work.
The silver lights peppering the giant are arrows.

page3.text:
That's probably underselling it, though.
It's more like strafing fire from a machine gun; each blow is powerful enough to pierce bedrock.
Eight shots of that.
The barrage is more than powerful enough to reduce a house to smoking rubble.

page4.text:
"Are you kidding me!? It did nothing!!!"
The giant is completely unaffected.

page5.text:
The two swords clash.
The massive sword wielded by the Berserker amid a hail of arrows...
...and the sword of Saber, who rushes to meet him, collide with a deafening clang, sending sparks flying.
"Hnng...!"
""
The two blades strain against each other.
In spite of Berserker's overwhelming strength, Saber does not give ground.
Silver lights flash through the darkness.
Just how much magical energy is stored inside that small body of hers?
She's clearly weaker, but she doesn't budge an inch.
She blocks, parries, and cuts through the whirlwind of attacks from the giant's massive sword.

page6.text:
...
The spectacle takes my breath away, and I'm not alone in that.
Toshaka and the giant's Master stand beside me, watching in fascination as the fight unfolds.

page7.text:
"...! Archer, back her up...!"
Another silver light flashes across the battlefield in response to Tohsaka's command.

page8.text:
It drives viciously into the giant's temple.
Archer's arrow impacts the giant with all the force of an artillery shell.
No matter how strong that giant might be, there's no way that won't do some real damage.

page9.text:
"Got him...!"
Saber follows up with a slash from her invisible sword.
However...
A savage counterattack strikes with such force that Saber is sent flying.

page11.text:
The black whirlwind surges after her.
Silver lights burst all around in attempts to obstruct the whirlwind.
It does...nothing.
Three arrows strike the giant's forehead with perfect precision, only to disappear.

page12.text:
"!!!"
The giant does not stop.
Saber catches his attack on her blade...

page13.text:
"Saber...!"
My scream does nothing.
The sheer force of Berserker's blow is such that, even though Saber blocks it, she's slammed to the ground with a tremendous thud.

page14.text:
"...!"
Is she feeling dizzy?
Saber is on her knees, not moving.
"This is it. Crush her, Berserker."
The girl's voice echoes across the battlefield.
The black giant charges towards Saber with terrifying speed.

page15.text:
"Archer, keep shooting...!"
Tohsaka yells as she starts running.
She must be intending to help Saber.
Tohsaka runs up the hill and takes what looks like a rock in hand.

page16.text:
"Gewicht, um zu Verdoppelung! (Pressure, shackles of obsidian!)"
She throws obsidian stones into the air and...
...a storm of silver light rains from the sky.
The attack doesn't even slow Berserker's charge.
"What a..."
...Monster.
Even I can see how absurdly strong he is now.
"Strong" isn't even a big enough word for that monster.
It must be protected by some kind of law of immortality woven with an insane amount of magical energy.

page17.text:
"It's fine, just ignore the noise.
Archer and Rin's attacks can't get past your Noble Phantasm anyway."
The girl's voice carries clearly to me.
The giant swings his huge sword...

page18.text:
...and...
Saber blocks bravely, but the force of the blow flings her away once again.
She is blown away dozens of meters up the hill.
Saber is sent in a perfectly straight line, like a pitcher's fastball before smashing into the barren road.

page19.text:
...
She must be dead.
She might have survived one blow.
But there's no way she's okay after receiving two blows from that giant's large sword. No chance.

page20.text:
The dark whirlwind surges toward her.
It's already over. Hasn't that thing had enough?
Still, the monstrous thing charges across the barren road.

page21.text:
...
She's going to die.
Even if, somehow, Saber is still alive, she'll die here and now.
And...
...so long as I'm here, I'm dead too.

page22.text:
"Run, if you can!"
I can't see Tohsaka, but I can hear her.
She went after Berserker.
Even after this monster is unscathed from so many powerful attacks, she means to keep fighting it?
